blurb: Bluefin Sound Charters, with its home port in New Rochelle, New York, is led by Captain Pedro DeCosta, who boasts more than two decades of experience navigating the Western Long Island Sound for striped bass, fluke, black fish, porgies & more. Captain Pedro extensive familiarity with these waters ensures a safe and enjoyable experience for anyone seeking to explore this beautiful region of the Long Island Sound.
